2317-4050-4826-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Repeat.

3713-4395-7839.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale using the ability granted to it by Lightning Prowess by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

654-2893-3875-7886.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Amulet of Vigor.
When the basic land enters, Amulet of Vigor, Tireless Provisioner and Beorn's Hospitality trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Beorn's Hospitality trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2092-3756-4954.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 7 power.
2092-3756-4954.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding two mana.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Izzet Boilerworks and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

It is an opponent's turn.

Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1172-1624-6108.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

3967-4120-4186-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
3967-4120-4186-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Scurry Oak, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 5.

3767-3918-7013-7223.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
3767-3918-7013-7223.description:
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1692-2239-2489-3732.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
1692-2239-2489-3732.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1692-2239-2489-3732.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist with haste.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

3542-3647-6991.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
3542-3647-6991.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Palinchron
When Donnie & April and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
3542-3647-6991.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

1978-3007-4306.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1978-3007-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least three.
1978-3007-4306.description:
Animate Nyx Lotus using Toymaker.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

3293-4826-5411-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-4826-5411-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-4826-5411-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Big Score and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Big Score, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Hoverstone Pilgrim twice by paying {2}, putting Big Score and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

2035-2279-4067.easyPrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
You control an additional creature.
2035-2279-4067.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gollum, untapping the permanent.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, returning Gollum from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1445-4871-5231-5477.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5231-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast Lethal Vapors by paying {2}{B}{B}.
As the opponent, activate Lethal Vapors by paying {0} an arbitrarily large number of times, causing that opponent to skip that many turns.

631-4050-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
631-4050-6249--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the persist creature dies, it and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

2452-3249-4446-5670--56.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric
Your life total is at least 2.
2452-3249-4446-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.

282-734-3073-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina and Lightning Runner.
282-734-3073-4918.description:
Declare Delina and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering them each twice.
Resolve a Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Bristling Hydra that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When the Bristling Hydra token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get at least {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 2 for the remaining Delina trigger.
Resolve the Lightning Runner triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite {E}, you may target any other creature(s) you control.

1187-2438-2527-2972-4549.notablePrerequisites: Ganax does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1187-2438-2527-2972-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's first ability by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Relic of Legends's second ability by tapping Ganax.
Ganax triggers, causing all Dragons you control to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Relic of Legends ability, untapping it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ganax.
When Ganax dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Ganax enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Ion Storm by paying {1}{R} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ganax, dealing two damage to any target.
Repeat.

Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 3.

The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

Elemental Mastery and Pemmin's Aura attached to the same creature.

Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

147-500.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Saw in Half
147-500.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Saw in Half, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Saw in Half, destroying Dualcaster Mage and creating two token copies of it with half its toughness and power, rounded up each time.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Ad Nauseam by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Resolve Ad Nauseam, revealing the top card of your library, putting that card into your hand and losing no life due to Teferi's Protection
Repeat the process in step 2 as many times as desired.
